  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise

assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import datetime
import unittest
from freezegun import freeze_time
seen = {}
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def tearDown(self):
        seen['torn_down'] = True
    def runTest(self):
        seen['during'] = datetime.datetime.now()
D = freeze_time('2020-01-02')(T)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=0).run(unittest.TestLoader().loadTestsFromTestCase(D))
assert result.testsRun == 1 and result.wasSuccessful()
print('during', seen['during'], 'torn_down', seen.get('torn_down'))
assert (seen['during'].year, seen['during'].month, seen['during'].day) == (2020, 1, 2)
after = datetime.datetime.now()
print('after', after)
assert (after.year, after.month, after.day) != (2020, 1, 2), 'frozen time was not released by teardown'
assert seen.get('torn_down'), 'original tearDown was not restored'
print('teardown_stop_ok')
